description: This PHP source file defines the TaxClass controller class within the Opencart Admin module, handling CRUD operations and task management related to tax classes, including listing, info retrieval, and cleaning up JSON files.

classes.name: TaxClass
classes.description: Controller class for handling tax class related tasks such as listing, retrieving info, and clearing cached JSON data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a list of tax classes and creates associated tasks for each tax class.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a specific tax class, saves it as a JSON file, and manages directory/file creation errors.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes cached JSON files related to tax classes.
